class.name: NetworkReader
class.brief_description: Read typed fields from a bounded binary gameplay payload.
class.description: Open a payload with [method open], read fields in the order the writer used, and check [method finish] before accepting the decoded values. Integers and floats use fixed widths and little-endian byte order. Each failed read records an error and later reads return neutral values. A field value of zero or an empty string can be valid.

method.name: open
method.description: Open bytes with a payload budget from 0 through 1,048,576 bytes. Oversized input returns a reader with [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA]. The reader retains its input until released.

method.name: read_bool
method.description: Read one byte, with 0 for false and 1 for true. Only 0 and 1 are valid. Return [code]false[/code] if reading fails and record the error.

method.name: read_u8
method.description: Read an unsigned 8-bit integer from 0 to 255. Return 0 if reading fails and record the error.

method.name: read_u16
method.description: Read an unsigned 16-bit integer from 0 to 65,535. Return 0 if reading fails and record the error.

method.name: read_u32
method.description: Read an unsigned 32-bit integer from 0 to 4,294,967,295. Return 0 if reading fails and record the error.

method.name: read_i8
method.description: Read a signed 8-bit integer from -128 to 127. Return 0 if reading fails and record the error.

method.name: read_i16
method.description: Read a signed 16-bit integer from -32,768 to 32,767. Return 0 if reading fails and record the error.

method.name: read_i32
method.description: Read a signed 32-bit integer from -2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647. Return 0 if reading fails and record the error.

method.name: read_i64
method.description: Read a signed 64-bit integer in the full Godot integer range. Return 0 if reading fails and record the error.

method.name: read_f32
method.description: Read a finite IEEE-754 binary32 float. Return 0.0 if reading fails and record the error.

method.name: read_f64
method.description: Read a finite IEEE-754 binary64 float. Return 0.0 if reading fails and record the error.

method.name: read_string
method.description: Read a UTF-8 string preceded by its unsigned 32-bit byte length. The optional limit counts encoded bytes. Invalid UTF-8, a leading byte-order mark, and embedded zero bytes fail. Return an empty string if reading fails and record the error.

method.name: read_bytes
method.description: Read a byte array preceded by its unsigned 32-bit length. The optional limit counts field bytes. Return an empty byte array if reading fails and record the error.

method.name: fail
method.description: Record a schema validation error when the fields are readable but the decoded values are invalid for the game. If [param reason] is [constant OK], records [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA]. Later operations preserve the first error.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Return the first reader error, or [constant OK] without checking for trailing bytes.

method.name: get_remaining
method.description: Return the number of payload bytes that have not been consumed.

method.name: finish
method.description: Return [constant OK] when every byte was consumed without errors. Record [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] for trailing bytes and preserve an existing error.
